symptom: re-executing the full describe of a flow whose if-merge wraps onto a new row (CxLayout.CX_VAL_Factory, CX_VAL_EmailTemplate in 02c) draws the merge-to-split flow out of the merge's right side instead of its bottom; layout flows, ELK, diff, with handles and create or modify's diff inherit it
cause: the flow leaving an if's closing merge had no annotation slot: describe wrote only the next split's to: top, and the top-level builder dropped an if's own @anchor(from:) (it honoured it only inside branch bodies)
fix: describe writes the merge exit side as from: on the if's @anchor (keyed on the merge the @merge line already names); the builder hands the if's from: to the merge-out flow via nextFlowAnchor, and case/type-split branches clear a nested if's leftover nextFlowAnchor
insight: the canonical describe hid it: omitting the split's @position let the rebuild wrap the row, and wrapping re-derives bottom->top. Only the full description, where every node is pinned, exposed that a merge's outgoing anchor was unwritable; compare full describe -> re-exec geometry against the stored flow, not canonical
